newsitem.title: USA: Dresser Industries in Russian joint venture.
newsitem.headline: Dresser Industries in Russian joint venture.

text.p: The DMD Division of Dresser Industries Inc said Thursday it has successfully begun a joint venture in Russia with Gazavtomatika, a sister company of Gazprom, the Russian gas transmission company.

The new company is called CJSC. DMD said the joint venture expects major market opportunities for ROOTS meters and instrumentation throughout Russia and the former Soviet Union, with a customer based including Gazprom and other natural gas distribution companies.

Assembly and testing facilities have been established at a factory owned by Gazavtomatika south of Moscow, said DMD, and the first large shipment of meter components for meter assembly at the Russian plant has been made from a facility in Houston, Texas.

The company said that in a country of 170 million people with the largest natural gas reserve in the world and no commercial or industrial gas meters, the opportunities for this joint venture are significant.
